train_gpt_decoder: train a GPT-like autoregressive decoder model on the enwik8 text dataset with configurable hyperparameters
build_transformer_model: build a TransformerWrapper with Decoder attention layers for autoregressive text generation
create_text_dataset: create a TextSamplerDataset that samples random sequences from text data for training and validation
generate_text_samples: generate text samples from the trained model using autoregressive decoding with KV caching
run_training_loop: run the training loop with gradient accumulation, validation, and periodic text generation
